remarks: Charming and spacious 3 bedroom rental with garage parking in the heart of Glenbrook! Walk through the front door and be WOWed by the unbelievable amount of living space. Large open concept dining and living rooms with arched doorways lead into den/office/play area and an additional separate, sunny office/guest/bonus room, too. Spacious kitchen with granite countertops, dishwasher, gas range and a huge pantry. 3 versatile bedrooms, large full bath and hardwood floors thru-out. Enjoy a private deck for fresh air, private laundry, extra basement storage, 1 garage parking space and additional off-street parking. Gas heat and updated Thermopane windows keeps this fantastic unit energy efficient. Walk to Glenbrook train station (1 mile), shops, restaurants, houses of worship & more! This is a must see!
